extracted.intended_audience: general readers, potential contributors, advertisers, press, and job applicants interacting with The Onion
extracted.subtask_description: The Onion's official 'About' / FAQ page describing its editorial policies, submission and employment rules, legal/licensing restrictions, contact channels, and other production/distribution guidelines for readers, potential contributors, advertisers, press, and job seekers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission policy — no outside submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: No, The Onion does not accept outside submissions of any kind. We will not respond to any unsolicited submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit prohibition on outside article/idea submissions; unsolicited submissions will not receive a response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resume / job-application policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not send résumés unless specifically told to do so in a job listing. Any unsolicited résumés will be immediately discarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employment opportunities are posted on the Careers page; only apply/respond to posted listings. Do not cold-submit résumés.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and spam policy for email
rubrics_metrics.description: Unsolicited bulk email, email attachments, and junk email of any kind are not accepted, and will be filtered and immediately discarded upon receipt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use provided contact links/addresses for appropriate inquiries; do not send attachments or mass/junk email.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback channel and response expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send all concerns to publicfeedback@theonion.com. The Onion cannot guarantee a response to any feedback to its content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is a designated feedback email, but no guaranteed reply; set expectation that many queries may go unanswered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advertising inquiries procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send all advertising inquiries to advertising@theonion.com. Please specify the business you would like to advertise, and the appropriate advertising sales representative will get back to you promptly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advertising requests should include business details; consult the Media Kit for more information on opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press / media inquiry channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send all inquiries to press@theonion.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designated contact for lesser media organizations wanting to cover The Onion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speaking engagement availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The writers and editors ... are available for speaking engagements at universities, conferences, ... and festivals. You can learn more here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writers/editors may accept speaking invitations; follow the provided link for details and booking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive access and requests
rubrics_metrics.description: This website contains all of The Onion's articles published from early 1996 through the present. You can browse by issue number, by topic, by section, or search the entire archive by keyword.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests for articles and graphics from past issues, including those published before 1996, should be sent to archive@theonion.com; The Onion will attempt to answer queries but cannot guarantee a response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Licensing and reprint restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Onion may not be reprinted or retransmitted in whole or in part without the express written consent of the publisher. To license material from The Onion, please send a request to permissions@theonion.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All reprint/retransmission requires express written consent; use permissions@ for licensing requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Privacy policy reference
rubrics_metrics.description: To read The Onion’s privacy policy, please click here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Privacy practices are documented separately; readers are directed to the dedicated privacy-policy page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age suitability / audience restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: The Onion is not intended for readers under 18 years of age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content is aimed at adult audiences; site explicitly disclaims suitability for minors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of names in stories
rubrics_metrics.description: The Onion uses invented names in all of its stories, except in cases where public figures are being satirized. Any other use of real names is accidental and coincidental.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy explaining fictionalization of names; real names appear only when satirizing public figures; otherwise any real-name occurrence is unintended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal stance on satire and litigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Please do not do that. The First Amendment protects satire as a form of free speech and expression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Onion invokes First Amendment protection for satire as its basis for defending content against legal challenges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Site availability / format
rubrics_metrics.description: The Onion is now available exclusively online without charge in order to take advantage of various charity tax benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content access is online-only and free; historical print editions are no longer distributed.
